_note: The Seam-E protected-ref fence STANDING falsifier suite (ED-264 / ADR-0035, 1.0 ceremony). Consumed by scripts/checks/falsifier-liveness.js --manifest, wired as a release-gate (release-gates.js gate `fence_falsifier_liveness`). This manifest IS the expected-set: falsifier-liveness runs EACH file per-file (>=1 test, skipped===0, fail===0) and BLOCKS on any file that is missing, skipped, or red — so the suite can never pass graceful-empty (a deleted/renamed fence falsifier fails liveness, not silently drops). Non-record-trust schema, so the record-trust-gate --built step is not applicable (falsifier-liveness skips it by schema).

surfaces.name: seam-e-protected-ref-fence
surfaces._note: The full fence set the 5-part arming battery exercises: brokered-write LANDS + un-brokered REFUSED (broker-acceptance), the reftxn refusal falsifiers (noop-content, not-installed, stdin-fail-closed), un-brokered merge bypass, fence-token forged/stale/injected, precommit-bypass harmless, and the ED-261 worktree-cwd fail-closed guard.
